newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Soda mulls yen bond issue - sources.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Soda mulls yen bond issue - sources.

text.p: Nippon Soda Co is considering issuing eight billion yen worth of yen-denominated bonds in overseas markets, underwriting sources said on Friday.
Some underwriters said Nippon Soda may set up a special-purpose company to buy the bonds. The special company would then issue convertible bonds using Nippon Soda's bonds as collateral.
The convertible bonds would be likely to have a provision stating they must be converted into stock at maturity, they said.
The bonds would be likely to bear no interest and have a two-year term, they said.
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday that if Nippon Soda were to issue the bonds, it would be the first Japanese firm to use such a fund procurement scheme.
A Nippon Soda official declined to comment on the possible bond issuance.
